data_fields.name: stain_countdown
data_fields.donor_constant: 30 flesh deaths for WATER; none for ENCHANTED_WATER

data_fields.name: ring_delay
data_fields.donor_constant: one visible time unit between a stain and the neighbour's ring (unit value not read)

data_fields.name: bleed_gate
data_fields.donor_constant: drops EVERYTHING and FLESH body; FROZEN downgrades drops to ONLY_INVENTORY

best_idea: A death leaves a stain only after a shared countdown in the area runs out, then the stain spreads to stainable neighbours one step later, so gore reads as a moving front instead of an instant decal.
decision_why: Keep the one-shot stain front as a client decal fed by server-verified flesh kills; keep the per-tile countdown as zone data; drop the 9x9 countdown-spending fallback unless a test shows it reads well, since it makes stains depend on nearby deaths.
acceptance: A server test kills N flesh creatures on a stainable tile and asserts the stain appears at the configured count, FROZEN or ONLY_INVENTORY deaths add no stain, and a seeded replay gives the same stain set; the client shows the stained tile on that kill and neighbours one step later.
